verdict.rationale: Deel is a workforce/payroll SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes MCP servers to gain tools; the evidence only shows Deel exposing its own MCP server for other agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to call into, which is the reverse relationship. This story's axis (product acting as an MCP client plugging in external tool servers) doesn't apply to a product of this kind.
